failureModes.prompt: If the network drops or changes while someone is recording, should the upload pick itself up again or should we tell them it failed?
failureModes.why: it decides whether a long recording can quietly disappear in transit

options.label: Resume by itself
options.consequence: nothing is lost, but a stuck upload can hide for a while

options.label: Fail visibly
options.consequence: the person knows immediately, and has to act

failureModes.provenBy: a test that severs the network mid-upload and asserts the recording still arrives or a visible failure is shown

failureModes.prompt: If someone leaves the app mid-recording, should recording continue or stop cleanly?
failureModes.why: phones suspend apps aggressively, and a half-saved recording is worse than none

options.label: Keep recording
options.consequence: needs background permission and more battery

options.label: Stop and save what exists
options.consequence: simpler and predictable, but the tail is lost

failureModes.provenBy: a test that backgrounds the app mid-recording and asserts the chosen behaviour (continue, or stop with a saved partial)

failureModes.prompt: If microphone access is refused or revoked, what should the person see?
failureModes.why: a silent failure here looks like the feature is broken

options.label: Explain and offer settings
options.consequence: more screens to design, far less confusion

options.label: Disable the control quietly
options.consequence: less work, and people report it as a bug

failureModes.provenBy: a test that denies the microphone permission and asserts the explanatory state renders

failureModes.prompt: Must a finished recording survive until the server confirms it, even if the app is killed?
failureModes.why: it decides whether we keep a copy on the phone and for how long

options.label: Keep it until confirmed
options.consequence: uses phone storage, nothing is lost

options.label: Best effort
options.consequence: simpler, and a rare recording is gone for good

failureModes.provenBy: a test that kills the app after recording and asserts the recording is still uploaded on next launch

failureModes.prompt: If a piece is sent twice after a retry, should the server keep one copy or both?
failureModes.why: retries are normal, and a doubled recording is a visible defect

options.label: Keep one copy
options.consequence: needs a stable id per piece

failureModes.provenBy: a test that sends the same chunk twice and asserts the stored recording contains it once

failureModes.prompt: If the sign-in expires during a long upload, should we renew it silently or stop and ask?
failureModes.why: long recordings routinely outlive a short-lived session

options.label: Renew silently
options.consequence: seamless, needs refresh handling on the upload path

failureModes.provenBy: a test that expires the session mid-upload and asserts the upload completes after silent renewal

failureModes.prompt: If the phone runs out of space during a long recording, should we stop early or lower the quality?
failureModes.why: it decides what someone loses when the device is full

options.label: Stop early and keep what exists
Lower the quality and continue
options.consequence: the whole session survives, quieter and rougher

failureModes.recommended: Stop early and keep what exists
failureModes.provenBy: a test that simulates a full disk and asserts the chosen behaviour (stop early, or degrade quality)
